source_text.ISS-0936: Issue ISS-0936 (local record docs/issues/ISS-0936.yaml, queue_ref Q-919, queue task 919, GH#2070; record may not yet be on this branch - PR #2071): scripts/uat_preflight.sh's qa-uat-env credential protocol (fetch_credential, ~line 290) expects the credential source's `token <user>` to print a line `Token: <jwt>`, but ai-dala-infra's qa-uat-env.sh `token <user>` prints a BARE JWT, so every actor login reports NO_PASSWORD. Fix: make fetch_credential accept a bare JWT line (three dot-separated base64url segments) as well as the `Token:` form. Add/adjust tests per project's existing preflight tests (none found under test/ -- TEST-DESIGNER decides a minimal in-repo test shape). Also update the script's header docs (qa-uat-env protocol paragraph) and scripts/README.md if they state the Token: form.

result.summary: FAIL. Substance is sound and independently verified: (1) CI wiring claim is TRUE - .github/workflows/ci.yml runs `mix letflow.check` (line 371) -> lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex shells out to scripts/test_parallel.sh -> `mix test --partitions N` (line 463), default test_paths recurses test/, mix.exs has no test_paths/test_pattern override, so test/scripts/uat_preflight_bare_jwt_test.exs IS picked up; grep of .github, mix.exs, lib, scripts finds NO reference to test/scripts/*_test.sh (only prose in config/test.exs:116), so the 3 existing .sh tests are not run by CI. (2) Code facts verified: fetch_credential line 290-306, Token: test at line 303, try_login maps kind None -> NO_PASSWORD at 321-323, UAT_PF_BASH set at line 96, header paragraph lines 26-38 states the Token: form at line 34; scripts/README.md has no Token:/qa-uat-env hits. (3) Coverage: Token: retained (R2,T2), bare JWT accepted (R3,T1), hostnames/noise rejected (R3/R4,T3,T4), no secret echo (sec 4,T6), header docs (sec 5), no implementation code (one signature + one regex only). However the gate is strict on deferral/ambiguity and the test shape still leaves buildable-from-the-design gaps (G1-G6). Route back to CODE-DESIGNER to close them; expected to be a small revision.
issues: G1 (deferral, design sec 6.2 + Q2): credential-source flag name is left as 'read from the argparse block'. It is already knowable: scripts/uat_preflight.sh line 112-114 defines --credential-source and --credential-protocol {qa-login,qa-uat-env}. Name the flags (and --base-url, --scenarios, --sha, --out) explicitly in the design.

G2 (deferral, sec 6.3 last paragraph): 'the test author captures [asserted substrings] before writing assertions' defers assertion shapes. Step-01 already recorded them: actors check `login failed: actor-swiftroute-lena(NO_PASSWORD)` and validity line `actor-swiftroute-lena@swiftroute=BAD_CRED`. Pin the exact substrings per test T1-T5 (and what 'actor status OK' means for T7).

G3 (ambiguity, sec 6.2 / T7): T7 and the http.server stub are 'optional ... drop it if flaky'. Design must decide: in or out. If in, specify stub routes (whole set of GETs the script issues, not just /api/v1/me/modules), port-0 handling, and the exact OK assertion; if out, remove T7 and the stub.

G4 (ambiguity, sec 6.2): scenario fixture is 'modeled on a file under test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/' with no shape given. Specify the minimal scenario file (file name, required keys, the actor key/value declaring actor-swiftroute-lena) or name the existing fixture to copy, so the test is buildable without discovery.

G5 (factual error, sec 6.2): fake JWT `eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ4In0.c2lnbmF0dXJl` is stated as 51 chars; it is 49 (20+1+15+1+12). Still passes the >=40 floor but the stated number is wrong; correct it.

G6 (minor, sec 9 Q1/Q3): open questions are labelled 'none block implementation; defaults stated' - acceptable for Q1 (explicit out of scope) but Q2 (see G1) is not a question, it is resolvable now; remove or resolve it.
